title: Impact of Vietnam Service on Long-Term Earnings
research_question: How does military service during the Vietnam War affect long-term earnings? The study aims to understand the causal impact of being drafted, using the draft lottery number as an instrumental variable for actual service.
data_description: The dataset includes 500 individuals with columns: y (log earnings), x (Vietnam service), z (draft lottery number), and controls (age, education). The draft lottery number serves as an instrument to account for the randomness of being drafted.
